shortDescription: Create or destroy a IONOS CLOUD Application Loadbalancer Forwarding rule.

options.name: algorithm
options.description: Balancing algorithm.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The Ionos API base URL.

options.name: application_load_balancer
options.description: The ID or name of the Application Loadbalancer.

options.name: certificate_fingerprint
options.description: The Ionos API certificate fingerprint.

options.name: client_timeout
options.description: The maximum time in milliseconds to wait for the client to acknowledge or send data; default is 50,000 (50 seconds).

options.name: datacenter
options.description: The ID or name of the datacenter.

options.name: forwarding_rule
options.description: The ID or name of the Application Loadbalancer forwarding rule.

options.name: http_rules
options.description: An array of items in the collection. The original order of rules is preserved during processing, except that rules of the 'FORWARD' type are processed after the rules with other defined actions. The relative order of the 'FORWARD' type rules is also preserved during the processing.

options.name: listener_ip
options.description: The listening (inbound) IP.

options.name: listener_port
options.description: The listening (inbound) port number; the valid range is 1 to 65535.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the Application Load Balancer forwarding rule.

options.name: new_server_certificates
options.description: An array of dict with information used to uploade new certificates and add them to the forwarding rule.A dict should contain 'certificate_file', 'private_key_file', 'certificate_chain_file'(optional), 'certificate_name' as keys.File paths should be absolute.

options.name: password
options.description: The Ionos password. Overrides the IONOS_PASSWORD environment variable.

options.name: protocol
options.description: The balancing protocol.

options.name: server_certificates
options.description: Array of items in the collection.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the resource.

options.name: token
options.description: The Ionos token. Overrides the IONOS_TOKEN environment variable.

options.name: username
options.description: The Ionos username. Overrides the IONOS_USERNAME environment variable.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the resource to be created before returning.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds.
